facts.business: P N Gadgil Jewellers Limited is primarily engaged in retail sales of all kinds of gems, diamonds, semi-precious stones and all types of jewellery made of gold, silver and other metals and all types of precious stones.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on fixed assets including CWIP

key_risks: High monetary value of precious items
Inventory distributed across multiple locations (retail stores, head-office, third-party job workers)
Significant risk of loss or theft given the value and nature of inventory
facts.related_party_note: Amount of loan or advances in the nature of loan to related party includes advances to Gadgil Diamond Pvt. Ltd. Which has been eliminated during the preparation of consolidated financial statement.
